bill_list.sql: SELECT t.bill_id,c.fee_name FROM bill t LEFT JOIN pay_fee_config c ON t.config_id=c.config_id AND c.community_id=t.community_id AND c.status_cd='0' WHERE t.community_id='audit-community' AND t.cur_bill='T' ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT 0,10

bill_owe_list.sql: SELECT t.owe_id,t.bill_id,t.fee_id,t.bill_amount_owed,pf.payer_obj_id FROM bill_owe_fee t INNER JOIN bill b ON t.bill_id=b.bill_id AND b.community_id=t.community_id LEFT JOIN pay_fee pf ON t.fee_id=pf.fee_id AND t.community_id=pf.community_id AND pf.status_cd='0' LEFT JOIN pay_fee_config pfc ON pf.config_id=pfc.config_id AND pfc.community_id=t.community_id AND pfc.status_cd='0' LEFT JOIN t_dict td ON pf.fee_type_cd=td.status_cd AND td.table_name='pay_fee_config' AND td.table_columns='fee_type_cd' WHERE t.community_id='audit-community' AND t.owner_id='audit-owner' AND b.cur_bill='T' AND b.review_state='PUBLISHED' AND t.state IN ('1000','3000') AND t.bill_amount_owed>0 ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT 0,10

payment_snapshots.sql: SELECT bof.owe_id,bof.bill_id,bof.fee_id,bof.bill_amount_owed,pf.payer_obj_id,pfc.fee_name FROM bill_owe_fee bof INNER JOIN bill b ON b.bill_id=bof.bill_id AND b.community_id=bof.community_id INNER JOIN pay_fee pf ON pf.fee_id=bof.fee_id AND pf.community_id=bof.community_id AND pf.status_cd='0' INNER JOIN pay_fee_config pfc ON pfc.config_id=pf.config_id AND pfc.community_id=pf.community_id AND pfc.status_cd='0' WHERE bof.community_id='audit-community' AND b.review_state='PUBLISHED' AND b.cur_bill='T' AND bof.state IN ('1000','3000') AND bof.bill_amount_owed>0 AND pf.end_time=bof.fee_end_time AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owner_app_user oau INNER JOIN building_owner bo ON bo.member_id=oau.member_id AND bo.community_id=oau.community_id AND bo.status_cd='0' WHERE oau.user_id='audit-user' AND oau.community_id=bof.community_id AND oau.state='12000' AND oau.status_cd='0' AND bo.owner_id=bof.owner_id) ORDER BY bof.owe_id

limitations: in_use means a code/config/framework dependency exists, not proof of recent traffic.
Exact counts were read without a cross-schema snapshot and can change during collection.
InnoDB TABLE_ROWS and EXPLAIN rows are estimates; sizes are allocated data/index bytes.
Source matching is token-based across src/main; comments and inactive modules may match.
Enabled c_service_sql templates are checked; external jobs/tools and runtime-assembled table names are not exhaustively known.
EXPLAIN uses synthetic identifiers and does not execute business queries; current tables are too small for realistic load estimates.
No classification authorizes dropping tables or deleting records.
